purpose: Freeze the primary matcher, the metric definitions, the fixture, and the thresholds for the TG-04 source-semantic lane, so a later score means something fixed in advance.

supersedes.reason: v1 asserts a polarity its own source denies on seven of 53 gold events, capping a source-faithful extractor at 0.8679 whole-event recall. v1 stays sealed and is not rescored.

corpus_attestation_index.purpose: Distinguishes a filtered-out corpus event from an invented one. Without it a corpus-faithful extractor and a hallucinator both score 0.1920.

primary_matcher.name: BOUNDED_TRIGGER_TOLERANCE_WITH_EXACT_ARGUMENTS_V1
primary_matcher.trigger: The gold trigger span must appear in the predicted span, and its offset within that prediction must land exactly on the gold start offset.
primary_matcher.arguments: Exact set equality on (role, event_role, exact_span, source_start).
primary_matcher.rationale: Chosen from measurement, not preference. Neither pre-existing matcher was correct and each had one half right.

evidence.observation: Widening every gold trigger by twelve characters, keeping its true start offset, takes whole-event recall from 1.0000 to 0.0000 under string equality and holds 53/53 under containment.
evidence.conclusion: String equality on a trigger measures span convention, not reading. Rejected.

evidence.observation: The tolerant matcher in finite_source_unit/controlled_event_trial accepts a superset of expected arguments, so a spurious extra argument on every event costs nothing.
evidence.conclusion: Superset argument matching is exploitable by padding. Rejected.

evidence.observation: Under the chosen matcher: gold verbatim 1.0000; trigger widened 1.0000; spurious extra argument 0.0000; trigger offset shifted by three 0.0000; polarity flipped 0.0000; event type wrong 0.0000.
evidence.conclusion: Tolerance is bounded on both sides. Every discrimination the exact matcher made is preserved.

primary_matcher.retained_as_diagnostic: Strict string-equality trigger matching remains reportable and is never a gate.

precision_definition.name: scope_aware_precision
precision_definition.excluded_from_denominator: Predictions that match no gold event but are attested in the source corpus. They are real annotations the importer filtered out; they earn no credit and take no penalty.
precision_definition.rationale: The panel keeps 53 of 472 corpus events, so a prediction absent from gold is ambiguous between correct-but-filtered and invented. Measured, a corpus-faithful extractor and a pure hallucinator both scored 0.1920 under the previous definition -- the gate could not tell them apart, and no choice of denominator over gold alone can.

thresholds.why_unchanged: These floors predate this protocol. No new numeric threshold is invented here: the direction adjustment holds that qualification thresholds become authoritative only after a noise floor is measured, and that measurement has not been run.
thresholds.not_yet_authoritative: A pass under these values is evidence the ruler works, not that the extractor qualifies. Qualification requires the Phase 4 replicate study.
thresholds.revision_rule: Changing any value creates a new protocol version. Values are bound to code by test and cannot drift silently.

calibration_required_before_any_model_sc.requirement: Every gated metric equals exactly 1.0 when the fixture's own gold is fed back as predictions.
calibration_required_before_any_model_sc.observed: PASS on v2 under this matcher.
calibration_required_before_any_model_sc.on_failure: The scorer is miscut. No model score may be interpreted.

calibration_required_before_any_model_sc.requirement: A corpus-faithful extractor must not be punished for events the importer filtered out.
calibration_required_before_any_model_sc.observed: Separated from a hallucinator by the attestation index.

calibration_required_before_any_model_sc.requirement: Flipping every gold polarity must fail the panel.
calibration_required_before_any_model_sc.observed: whole-event recall 0.0000, polarity fidelity 0.0000, over 12 REFUTE records in v2 versus 5 in v1.

lane_separation.source_semantic: Governed by this protocol. The only lane that gates.
lane_separation.bionlp_cg_projection: Measured and reported separately. Never used to reverse a source-semantic result.
lane_separation.note: The 40 selected documents are a development panel. Results on them are never evidence of generalization; a sealed held-out set remains untouched.

known_limits.panel_retention: 53 of 472 corpus events (11.2%). 237 events are dropped by an undocumented _MIN_EVENT_ARGUMENTS = 2 policy constant and 174 by a genuine schema limit on event-valued arguments; see the exclusion ledger.
known_limits.scored_documents: Only the 17 EVENT_GOLD documents are scored. Predictions on the 18 representability-stress documents are discarded before scoring.
known_limits.development_only: This protocol governs the development panel. It does not preregister a qualification run.
known_limits.noise_floor: Unmeasured. Run-to-run variance on the extraction model has not been established, so a single passing run is not a repeatable result.
known_limits.model_snapshot: Unavailable. No dated snapshot is published for gpt-5.6-luna -- the provider serves the whole 5.6 family as floating aliases, while 45 other models it offers do carry -YYYY-MM-DD suffixes. artana.toml [models.formal] therefore names the model explicitly, so a defaults edit cannot silently move it, but the alias itself can still move under a run. D8 cannot be satisfied for this model.
known_limits.returned_model_unobserved: The provider-returned model id is never read. The call is made inside the third-party artana kernel, which echoes back the requested id rather than reading it off the response, and no repository-side adapter sees the raw response. So alias drift is undetectable here; see issue #206.

governance.code_binding: tests/unit/test_evaluation_protocol_preregistration.py fails if the code constants diverge from this document.
